shots.note: wide establishing down the pillared crypt corridor in cold blue light, skeletons lying ahead; Haon enters frame left with the ember and walks in (left to right, into depth)
insert, low on the floor: the nearest skull; its eye sockets wake, it lifts and the skeleton sits up and rises
medium three-quarter front on Haon: she freezes, ember at her belly, then backs off
low wide from the floor: the skeletons rise one after another, Combat idle, facing the camera / Haon
tracking dolly alongside the patrol: the skeleton file walks screen right to left toward the pillars
close, low handheld from the corridor: Haon crouched behind the pillar against the wall, ember hugged, peeking; skeleton legs pass in the foreground
high angle over the corridor: the pillar between Haon (crouched at the wall) and the skeleton file walking past and away
close on Haon at the wall, low handheld: she turns her head after the skeletons walking away, exhales, rises
medium from the corridor: she slips out from behind the pillar and sneaks back toward the corridor with slow careful steps
wide release from between the near pillars: Haon sneaks on along the emptied corridor, screen left to right, and exits frame right; cold tone
